text: Hoa Sen Home expands affiliate marketing on e-commerce platforms

HÀ NỘI - Hoa Sen Home, the building materials and home furnishings retail chain operated by Hoa Sen Group, is expanding its online sales channels through an affiliate marketing programme on Shopee and TikTok Shop, offering content creators commissions of 8-10 per cent on eligible sales.
Under the programme, participants can select products from Hoa Sen Home's online stores, attach shopping links to videos and livestreams, or share affiliate links with online communities.
Commissions are paid on orders that meet the platforms' eligibility requirements.
The programme has already generated orders through the two platforms, indicating initial sales activity through the affiliate channel.
Trần Đình Tài, Deputy General Director of Hoa Sen Group, said the expansion of affiliate marketing on Shopee and TikTok Shop was part of Hoa Sen Home's strategy to broaden its online sales channels.
The company aims to strengthen links with content creators and expand consumer access to its range of building materials, bathroom and kitchen equipment, and household products, he said.
The move comes as short-form videos and livestreams become increasingly integrated into online shopping.

Through creator-generated content, products can reach consumers via product demonstrations, recommendations and discussions in online communities, rather than relying solely on direct advertising or searches for online stores.
Hoa Sen Home operates under a one-stop-shop model, offering more than 15,000 product lines for different stages of home construction and completion.
The chain opened its first modern retail outlet in 2021, building on Hoa Sen Group's more than two decades of experience in the building materials sector.
It has since expanded to more than 400 outlets nationwide, including over 150 modern retail stores. - VNS
